title: AgentAttemptResult
description: Host-captured record of one agent attempt (OQ-03 sections 3 to 5). The runner records provenance, outcome and usage. The model writes only the role output; the runner parses it with the shared validator and uploads it as an immutable artefact before it posts this record, which carries it by digest. The model never sees or writes this envelope. A valid adverse finding is a completion.

AgentProvenance.title: AgentProvenance
AgentProvenance.description: session_id is the fresh executor session. input_hash and bundle_hash are the request and bundle actually used; each must match the dispatch. executor_version, provider, model and effort are the values the executor reports, or unknown when it reports none. runner is the host executable.

UnreportedName.title: UnreportedName
UnreportedName.description: Nothing reported the value. It is never inferred from the requested profile.

AgentOutcome.title: AgentOutcome
AgentOutcome.description: Exactly one of the seven attempt outcomes of OQ-03 section 4. Tool-call outcomes are not attempt outcomes. Only completion carries role output. Within the attempt cap, timeout and malformed_result are retried, as are a lease expiry and a runner crash, which are not outcomes. refusal, denied_capability, authentication_failure and cancellation are not retried (OQ-05 section 4).

AgentCompletion.title: AgentCompletion
AgentCompletion.description: The role output passed the shared validator. output is the uploaded role result; the API parses it again before any guarded write.

AgentMalformedResult.title: AgentMalformedResult
AgentMalformedResult.description: Final output failed validation after the executor ran. SCHEMA_INVALID covers unknown fields, missing fields, unknown categories and wrong types. REFERENCE_INVALID covers a cited method, source, evidence or element absent from the request. IDENTITY_MISMATCH covers a session, input hash or bundle hash in the executor's report that differs from the dispatch, found after the run.

AgentDeniedCapability.title: AgentDeniedCapability
AgentDeniedCapability.description: The host refused to start or continue the executor: execution is disabled, the executable is missing, a capability is unsupported or denied, or the installed bundle differs from the dispatch (BUNDLE_MISMATCH, found before the executor starts). No model success is recorded.

AgentCancellation.title: AgentCancellation
AgentCancellation.description: The host terminated the process tree on cancellation. It does not prove that a remote request stopped or cost nothing.

AgentTimeout.title: AgentTimeout
AgentTimeout.description: The host terminated the process tree at the deadline.

AgentDiagnostic.title: AgentDiagnostic
AgentDiagnostic.description: Bounded diagnostic without credentials or full sensitive context.

AgentUsage.title: AgentUsage
AgentUsage.description: Usage captured by the host. Claude Code cost is estimated. A missing report is unknown and keeps the full reservation.
